name: 2D Metroidvania Template
agentBrief: A complete Hollow Knight-style 2D metroidvania. PLAYER: scenes/player/player.tscn driven by scripts/player/player_controller.gd (CharacterBody2D: run, jump, double jump, dash, wall slide/jump, stomp-to-kill, melee attack; movement feel is tuned via @export vars — change those, not the physics code). ABILITIES: scripts/autoloads/ability_manager.gd tracks dash/wall_climb/double_jump/down_attack/charged_attack. Pickups (scenes/systems/ability_pickup.tscn) ship for dash (room_02) and wall_climb (room_04); dash is also granted on a fresh boot. AbilityGate (scenes/systems/ability_gate.tscn) and Door.requires_ability exist, but no shipped room places a gate or an ability-locked door -- the world is fully open until you gate it. WORLD: 7 interconnected rooms in scenes/rooms/room_01-07.tscn managed by RoomManager + SceneTransition autoloads (all registered in room_manager.gd room_paths). scenes/levels/level_01-03.tscn, the level_select/victory/level_complete UI and the gem/checkpoint/bounce_pad/one_way_platform/level_end systems are legacy linear-platformer content that nothing in the room flow loads. ENEMIES: patrol + flying enemies in scenes/enemies/, boss fight in scenes/bosses/crystal_queen.tscn. SYSTEMS: benches (heal, save, respawn point), coins, shop UI (scenes/ui/shop.tscn, opened by an NPC with is_shopkeeper=true; shopkeeper dialogue ships but no shopkeeper NPC is placed yet), quests via QuestManager + quest_journal UI, saves via SaveManager, game-feel via JuiceManager (screenshake/squash). UI: hud, pause_menu (Resume / Quest Journal / Map / Restart / Main Menu), quest_journal, map, shop, main_menu, game_over in scenes/ui/; dialogue boxes are built by scripts/npcs/dialogue_runner.gd. hud.gd reads its nodes with %Name, and the four nodes carry unique_name_in_owner=true in hud.tscn -- keep both sides in sync. INPUT ACTIONS (already bound): move_left, move_right, move_down, jump, dash, attack, interact, pause. AUTOLOADS (9, wired in project.godot): EventBus, AbilityManager, RoomManager, GameManager, QuestManager, SaveManager, SceneTransition, JuiceManager, AudioManager — extend these rather than adding parallel singletons. NOTE: the game boots straight into gameplay at scenes/rooms/room_01.tscn (run/main_scene); the main menu is reached from the pause menu (GameManager.go_to_main_menu()). AUDIO: AudioManager is a stub with the crossfade/SFX plumbing in place and no audio files. VERIFY: projects created with summer create include tests/autopilot/run.sh, which must exit 0 with zero engine errors on a pristine project. CUSTOMIZE BY: reskinning sprites in assets/, retuning player @exports, editing room layouts, swapping enemy/boss behavior, retheming UI — do not rewrite the autoload spine.

userFacing.tagline: A Hollow Knight-style metroidvania starter: tight combat, ability pickups, a boss, NPCs and quests.
highlights: Tuned platformer controller with double jump, dash, wall jump and stomp
7 interconnected rooms with dash and wall-climb ability pickups
Boss fight, patrol + flying enemies, melee combat
Quests, shop UI, benches and a JSON save system
UI set: HUD, pause menu, quest journal, map, shop, main menu, game over
